title: pengchujin/aerial-tv
why_read: A practical open-source Android TV launcher that removes ads and clutter from Chinese smart TVs, useful for anyone dealing with increasingly ad-laden TV interfaces.
analysis: This is a custom home-screen launcher for Android TV devices from brands like Xiaomi and TCL, styled after Apple's tvOS, designed to replace the stock, ad-heavy interface. It's a straightforward consumer-facing utility rather than a novel technical breakthrough, but it addresses a widely felt annoyance with smart TV software. The significant star count suggests real demand for ad-free alternatives to manufacturer-provided launchers.
